answer: Builder plan: synchronous validation ceremony. A public beacon pulse fixes each session 6 h ahead; at the pulse every ID gets 6 fresh tasks plus 20 peer outputs to rank, all due within 120 s (proposed). Miss it and the ID is unvalidated, unpaid that cycle. An operator with 500 clones must hold a flat load mesa: 500 live agents peaking together for the full window, where shared rate limits and hardware ceilings bite at once. Proposed numbers; to measure: clone-fleet pass rate vs solo-agent baseline.
